info.title: Cloud Edge Backend API
info.description: S1-S6 workflow backend, management and MET-001 algorithm measurement: execution snapshots, guarded logical deletion, ADMIN/USER accounts, image build/distribution, deployments and committed SDK reports. One execution chain; no pod-duration throughput fallback, physical purge or full Kestra feature parity.

host.description: Empty matches all hosts; lowercase DNS or *.domain.

resourceVersion.description: Omit for creation; exact current Kubernetes value for update.

DeploymentResources.description: Per application-container Kubernetes quantities. Omitted/null request object preserves existing resources; supplied object replaces only CPU/memory requests and limits. Blank/null fields remove explicit values; Kubernetes admission/defaulting still applies. Positive quantities, request <= limit when both supplied.

durationMs.description: Only SUCCEEDED, positive replicas, continuous observation of same UID/generation. Includes on-request distribution and rollout. SCALE is not a deployment benchmark.

exploration.description: DQN only; default 0. Explicit research exploration, disabled during evaluation.

Offload.description: Only execution=TERMINAL. RULE selects a layer; FIXED requires layer. DQN requires pinned measured six-state modelVersion and trusted gateway/single non-retrying file task; complete state required. Optional exploration defaults to 0. Resource owns layer scope and concrete placement; candidateClusters is forbidden.

DqnModel.description: Linear/ReLU/Linear row-major weights. Java validates matching hidden dimensions and finite bounded values. No built-in model.

id.description: Actual terminal/cluster after Resource allocation; null while only the layer is decided. Never used to choose a cluster.

inferenceMs.description: DQN model forward-pass latency in milliseconds, measured at the edge gateway. Null for FIXED/RULE and historical decisions. Excludes RPC, queueing, scheduling and task execution.

decisionMs.description: Backend decision-processing latency in milliseconds, from OffloadingTaskAdapter entry until the target layer is selected, before observation persistence. Includes state preparation and, for DQN, gateway round trip. Null for historical decisions. Excludes worker queueing, placement, task execution and result transfer.

OffloadingSample.description: One observation per Attempt. measurement=null for historical/ineligible records; never convert legacy 13D into six-dimensional samples. New state is log1p(measurement.inputs); reward comes only from terminal feedback.

elapsedSeconds.description: Positive monotonic seconds; null only for UNMEASURED after original process timing was lost.

inputs.description: D, QL, QE, QC in MiB; TE, TC in seconds. Missing is null, never zero.

trainable.description: Both decision states, terminal reward and confirmed non-cancelled task completion exist; not evidence of a trained DQN. Continuous-stream tail remains incomplete.

origin.description: Persisted terminal/gateway ownership; null if no ingress receipt. clusterId is the source edge, not the actual execution placement.

values.description: SELECT only: ordered nonblank string options. SELECT requires values; defaultValue and supplied non-null values must be members.

port.description: A declared task output; Loop ports contain ordered arrays.

path.description: Starts with value or index; only inside a Loop item.

priority.description: Runnable tasks only. Higher first, equal FIFO, dependencies unchanged, non-preemptive.

condition.description: If expression must render true or false; choice persisted

Task.description: Log requires message; Sleep requires duration. Application/Http/Sql require timeout and their matching container/http/sql section, forbidding message/duration. Http supports GET/POST; POST forbids retry. Sql supports one parameterized read-only SELECT. Sequential/Parallel/Dag require tasks; If requires condition and then, optionally else. Control tasks forbid message/duration/retry/timeout/priority. Leaf priority is 0..100, omitted means 0, higher first among ready candidates, equal FIFO; non-preemptive. dependsOn is allowed only on direct children of the same Dag; referenced task outputs must be upstream. Task IDs are globally unique; max 100 tasks, nesting max 16. Leaf durations/timeout/retry interval: PT0.001S..PT24H.

Repeat.description: Fixed 1..100 iterations, resolved at start. Matching initial/feedback state keys, excluding iterations/iterationCount. Each round is a barrier; no nested Repeat. External consumers reference Repeat outputs, never its children.

Loop.description: Snapshot an array of 0..1000 items; sequential child tasks per item. Bounded concurrent groups. Declared outputs collected in input order after all items succeed. Repeat may contain Loop; Loop cannot contain Repeat/Loop. See s5-loop.md.

candidateClusters.description: Resolve to a nonempty unique array. Static arrays normalize to LITERAL at parse time.

execution.description: TERMINAL requires authenticated edge ingress provenance and an administrator-configured Docker context. It forbids container.candidateClusters; CLUSTER requires them and forbids offload.

namespaceFiles.description: Local input filename -> same-namespace pinned UTF-8 file revision. /cea-work/in/<name>; at most 256KiB total.

Container.description: Explicit application task. Requires timeout. Inputs staged at /cea-work/in/name; outputs collected from /cea-work/out/name. Dataset parameter P also injects P_PATH. No automatic Flow inputs. See s4-job-execution.md.

webhook.description: Opt-in authenticated POST webhook; JSON body contains Flow inputs

afterExecution.description: Durable same-chain tasks after terminal result; failures never rewrite result; inspect TaskRuns

slaViolatedAt.description: First Executor observation exceeding SLA, durable; null if not observed

Execution.description: QUEUED has not been admitted. CREATED/RUNNING/KILLING occupy a Flow concurrency slot until Finally completes. FAIL admission returns a terminal FAILED execution without attempts or cleanup.

parentTaskRunId.description: Nearest dynamic Repeat/Loop parent TaskRun UUID; null at root scope

iteration.description: Zero at root; one-based local round/item ordinal under its dynamic parent. item.index is zero-based.

TaskRun.description: Control tasks have TaskRuns but no Attempts. If outputs evaluationResult once; unselected descendants are SKIPPED. QUEUED and KILLING apply only to Execution.

ResourceCluster.description: Administrator-declared cluster; enabled is permission to use, not observed health. Contains no endpoint or credentials.

uri.description: s3://bucket/key object locator, without endpoint credentials, query, fragment, port or parent traversal.

DatasetVersion.description: Immutable registration including its location set. Repeating the same registration (location order ignored) returns 200; different content at the same version returns 409. Registration does not upload or verify object existence.

reasons.description: CLUSTER_DISABLED, FORMAT_MISMATCH:dataset/version, DATASET_NOT_LOCAL:dataset/version; all apply cumulatively.

image.description: Explicit repository:tag or repository@sha256:digest. Reference syntax only; not pulled or verified.

choices.description: Values must match type. SELECT requires 1..100 distinct nonblank strings; any default must belong to choices. Existing scalar choices remain supported.

resourceVersion.description: Omit for creation; exact current Kubernetes value for update.

when.description: Existing Pebble condition over inputs/vars; must render true to admit execution

maxDuration.description: ISO-8601 PT0.001S..PT24H, elapsed startedAt to main completion including Errors/Finally; violation only, not cancellation

RegistryImageDetail.description: Current application-version associations (including distributed copies) and Deployment references prevent deletion regardless of task state. Job/Pod history is not queried. Existing index/distribution or lookup failures remain blockers.

applications.description: Sorted active applicationId/version associations; deleted catalog entries are excluded.

deployments.description: Sorted cluster / Kubernetes namespace / Deployment name references; includes zero replicas, no Job/Pod history.
